comment: ASP.NET Core MVC on ASP.NET Core 10, one controller per family under Implementation/Controllers. MVC is part of ASP.NET Core's shared framework, which no package reference resolves: the aspnet runtime image supplies it, so the image's digest in the Dockerfile pins the version /__meta reports, and package names that image. packages.lock.json pins the OpenAPI packages. The suite is UnitTests/, xunit over WebApplicationFactory<Program>, and never reaches the image. upgrade is null because the version moves with the image digest, and dotnet package update moves every package to its newest release, majors included.

client.generator: Kiota 1.35.0, a .NET local tool that Client.csproj runs, because ASP.NET Core recommends no generator of its own

noHandler.cors.preflight: ASP.NET Core's CORS middleware answers the preflight for the action [EnableCors] marks, and no action runs.
noHandler.errors.unmatched: The router answers a path no route matches with 404, and ProblemDetails writes the body.
noHandler.errors.wrong_method: The router answers a method the path has no action for with 405, and ProblemDetails writes the body.

authorized.mechanism: ASP.NET Core authorization: [Authorize] with a policy on this one action, over a bearer-token authentication scheme of its own

baseline.builtin: The action returns the text as a ContentResult.

body.mechanism: MVC's model validation: DataAnnotations on the order and line types, which [ApiController] runs before the action and refuses with its automatic 400. The bind actions bind a subtype marked [ValidateNever]. The first-error action's filter checks one property at a time with DataAnnotations, because they cannot stop at the first failure

cache.mechanism: ASP.NET Core output caching, which MVC reads from [OutputCache] on each action, with a named policy for each vary row that varies by its request headers

compressed.mechanism: ASP.NET Core's response compression middleware on the whole application, at gzip's fastest level

cors.mechanism: ASP.NET Core CORS with a named policy, which [EnableCors] requires on the CORS controller alone

errors.builtin: The router answers a miss with 404 and a method a route lacks with 405, and ASP.NET Core's ProblemDetails writes the body. [ApiController] answers a body the input formatter cannot read with MVC's own 400, and an action's NotFound with MVC's ProblemDetails.

etag.mechanism: A result filter on the two actions that serialises the answer with MVC's JSON options and hashes it with SHA-1, handing both to MVC's FileContentResult, which sets ETag and answers a matching If-None-Match with 304

forms.builtin: MVC's form binding binds the urlencoded form to a record, and the multipart fields and the IFormFile by name.

headers.builtin: [FromHeader] parameters, the account as an int.

items.builtin: One action per method on /items/{id:int}, the id bound as an int, with HEAD beside GET on the read action.

json.mechanism: A source-generated JsonSerializerContext first in MVC's resolver chain, so System.Text.Json writes from generated metadata

middleware.mechanism: No-op action filters on the action, four or sixteen of them

parameters.builtin: Route values bound as ints by MVC's model binding.

query.builtin: MVC's model binding: an action parameter for the one value, and a record bound through its constructor for the eight.

sse.builtin: The action returns TypedResults.ServerSentEvents, ASP.NET Core 10's result for server-sent events, which MVC runs as an IResult and which writes each row as an event.

static.mechanism: ASP.NET Core's static-file middleware over the payload directory, under /static

stream.builtin: The action writes each row and a newline to the response, and flushes.

template.mechanism: An MVC Razor view, rendered by View() through the view engine AddControllersWithViews registers
